description: Returns every user of an app with all it holds on them (saved data, public info, messages, stats, language, email if shared, purchase balances); sample users are left out. Personal data: the owner and team roles that read users. Paged: pass `next` as `after` until `next` is null, also after a page marked partial (cut for time). One user: neblla_get_user.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

name: neblla_export_users
title: Export an app's users
